experience.title:
Tap through the lines.
Make the choices yourself.
experience.body: A short taste of Habom's mood. Step through the dialogue one line at a time, pick your answers, and see where the story goes.
experience.step1Body: Press while the text is appearing to show it all at once, and press again to go to the next line.
experience.step2Body: Click or tap, or use the 1 · 2 · 3 keys. There are three choice points.
experience.step3Body: Your choices lead to different endings. The ending card recaps what you picked, and you can play again.
experience.roommatesNote: Names and personalities come from the official synopsis.
experience.noticeTitle: This is a draft sample script
experience.noticeBody: The lines and scenes were newly written for this concept and are not official game content. They will be replaced once the real script, characters, length and sound are decided. There is no audio.
experience.only: Available only for games under Habom.
experience.keys: Enter · Space next / 1 · 2 · 3 choose / R restart / Esc close

studio.title: Studio Habom
